text:
A length of metal wire is used as a resistor in a circuit.
Which change results in an increase in current in the circuit?
A
connecting a second identical length of wire in parallel with the original wire
B
connecting a second identical length of wire in series with the original wire
C
decreasing the thickness of the wire
D
increasing the length of the wire

options.label: A
options.text: connecting a second identical length of wire in parallel with the original wire

options.label: B
options.text: connecting a second identical length of wire in series with the original wire

options.label: C
options.text: decreasing the thickness of the wire

options.label: D
options.text: increasing the length of the wire
